# OAE Data Protocol: Schema Documentation

> Schema and documentation for Ocean Alkalinity Enhancement (OAE) metadata: projects, experiments,
> datasets and variables. Every page listed here is plain markdown.

## Drafting metadata

- [oae-metadata skill](https://schema.oaedata.org/skill/SKILL.md): step-by-step instructions for drafting an OAE metadata
  file from project documents and data files. Its reference files and validator are in the same folder.
- [JSON Schema](https://schema.oaedata.org/skill/assets/oae_data_protocol.schema.json): the schema a metadata file must follow.
- [Validator](https://schema.oaedata.org/skill/scripts/validate.py): `python3 validate.py file.json`, standard library only.
- [The skill as a zip](https://schema.oaedata.org/oae-metadata.zip)
